items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: The interviewee discusses Tony Leonardi extensively. Joe Farrell is mentioned only by the interviewer as a separate entity ('Joe Farrell was there a while') and later the interviewer mentions 'His brother Joe' (referring to Tony Leonardi's brother, Joe Leonardi, not Joe Farrell). ctx.x: No it wasn’t Joe, Joe Farrell was there a while, and then Frank Foster was on the band too. And Bill Chase of course. Great trumpet player. Great players man. Tony Leonardi. I got him on the gig.
